step0.title: Welcome to Double mode!
step0.desc:
Twice the queens this level!
Let's go over the rules.

step1.label: Rule 1 / 3
step1.title: 2 queens per color
step1.desc:
Place exactly 2 queens
in each colored region.

step2.label: Rule 2 / 3
step2.title: 2 queens per row & column
step2.desc:
Every row and every column
must have exactly 2 queens too.

step3.label: Rule 3 / 3
step3.title: Queens can't touch
step3.desc:
No two queens can touch,
including diagonally.

step0.title: Welcome to Queens!
step0.desc:
Place 4 queens on a 4×4 board without breaking the rules.
Let's go over them one by one.

step1.label: Rule 1 / 4
step1.title: One queen per color
step1.desc:
The board is split into 4 colored regions.
Place exactly one queen in each region.

step2.label: Rule 2 / 4
step2.title: One queen per row
step2.desc:
Each row can hold only one queen.
Two or more in a row breaks the rule!

step3.label: Rule 3 / 4
step3.title: One queen per column
step3.desc: Each column can hold only one queen too.

step4.label: Rule 4 / 4
step4.title: Queens can't touch
step4.desc:
No two queens can touch!
That includes diagonals.

step5.title: Practice: mark ✕
step5.desc:
Tap to mark ✕ on cells where a queen can't go.
Tap the glowing cell!

step6.title: Practice: place a queen
step6.desc:
Double-tap quickly to place a queen.
Place the orange queen on the glowing cell!

step7.title: Row elimination
step7.desc:
The orange queen is in row 0.
No other queen can go in that row,
so mark ✕ on the blue cell (0,3)!

step8.title: Place the blue queen
step8.desc:
With row 0 ruled out, only (1,3)
is left in the blue region!
Double-tap to place the blue queen.

step9.title: Adjacent elimination
step9.desc:
(2,2) touches the blue queen (1,3)
diagonally, so it's out.
Mark it with ✕!

step10.title: Place the purple queen
step10.desc:
Rule out column 1 and the touching cells,
and only (3,2) is left in the purple region!
Double-tap to place the purple queen.

step11.title: Last queen!
step11.desc:
Once three queens are down, only (2,0)
is left in the green region. Double-tap
to finish the puzzle! 🎉

home.metaTitle: Queens Puzzle - Free Online Crown Quest Logic Game | Puzzle Garden
home.metaDesc: Play the Queens puzzle free online. Place one queen in every colored region with none in the same row or column or touching. Crown Quest has 1000 free stages, no download needed.
home.intro: Crown Quest is a logic puzzle where you place exactly one crown in every colored region, row, and column of the board. No two crowns can touch, even diagonally, and every condition must hold at once. As you level up, the boards get bigger and the placements get trickier!

rule1.label: Rule 1

rule1.desc: Place exactly one queen in each colored region.

rule2.label: Rule 2
rule2.title: One queen per row & column
rule2.desc: Each row and each column can hold only one queen too.

rule3.label: Rule 3
rule3.title: Queens can't touch
rule3.desc: No two queens can touch. That includes horizontal, vertical, and diagonal neighbors.
